{{Nihongo|'''Kohji Matsumoto'''|松本 耕二|Matsumoto Kōji}} is a Japanese mathematician. He is professor of mathematics at [[Nagoya University]] in [[Nagoya]], Japan. 

== Education and career ==
Matsumoto graduated from the [[University of Tokyo]] in 1981.<ref name=":0">{{Cite web |last=Kohji |first=Matsumoto |title=MATSUMOTO, Kohji |url=https://www.math.nagoya-u.ac.jp/en/people/download/faculty/matsumoto_kohji_en.pdf |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20201023091547/https://www.math.nagoya-u.ac.jp/en/people/download/faculty/matsumoto_kohji_en.pdf |archive-date=23 October 2020 |access-date=22 January 2023 |website=www.math.nagoya-u.ac.jp}}</ref> He got a doctoral degree from [[Rikkyo University]] in 1986,<ref name=":0" /> advised by Akio Fujii.<ref name=":1">{{Cite web |title=Kohji Matsumoto - The Mathematics Genealogy Project |url=https://www.genealogy.math.ndsu.nodak.edu/id.php?id=144727 |access-date=2023-01-22 |website=www.genealogy.math.ndsu.nodak.edu}}</ref> His thesis was titled ''Discrepancy estimates for the value-distribution of the Riemann zeta-function''.<ref name=":1" /> He became a lecturer at [[Iwate University]] in 1987 and an associate professor there in 1990.<ref name=":0" /> He joined Nagoya University in 1995, becoming a full professor there in 2001.<ref name=":0" />

=== Research ===
Matsumoto's specializations include [[number theory]], zeta theory, and [[mathematical analysis]]. He is mostly recognized for the [[Matsumoto zeta function]], a zeta function named after him. He co-edited ''Analytic Number Theory'' (2002), a book about [[prime numbers]], divisor problems, [[Diophantine equations]], and other topics related to [[analytic number theory]], including Diophantine approximations, and the theory of zeta and L-functions.<ref>{{cite book|title= Analytic Number Theory|author1=Jia, C. |author2=Matsumoto, K.|isbn= 9781402005459|lccn= 2002071069|series= Developments in Mathematics|url= https://books.google.com/books?id=2zqtTh2uh1IC|year= 2002|publisher= Springer}}</ref> His other book, ''Algebraic And Analytic Aspects Of Zeta Functions And L-Functions'', a compilation of lectures at the French-Japanese Winter School, was published in 2010.<ref>{{cite book |title= Algebraic and Analytic Aspects of Zeta Function and L―functions |author= Bhowmik, G. |author2 = Matsumoto, K. |author3 = Tsumura, H. |isbn= 9784931469563 |series= MSJ Memoirs |year= 2010 |publisher= 日本数学会}}</ref>
